cases.prompt: Bootstrap an EPAC repository with dev and prod pacEnvironments and GitHub Actions pipelines.

expect.label: use GitHub OIDC federation — no client secrets in pipelines
separate service principal per environment scoped to its management group
epac-dev pointed at isolated management group — no production workloads
plan on PR, deploy on merge — plan diff as PR comment or artifact

cases.prompt: How do I safely promote a policy from Audit to Deny in production using EPAC?

expect.label: start as Audit, monitor compliance, then promote to Deny
review the plan diff before deploying — broad Deny can break pipelines
never run Deploy-PolicyPlan directly against prod outside a pipeline
pacOwnerId partitions ownership — don't share EPAC instance with another team

cases.prompt: How do I manage exemptions in EPAC and avoid them becoming permanent policy holes?

expect.label: exemptions stored in policyExemptions/ folder with expiry date and justification
time-bound with expiry — EPAC alerts near expiry
